source.citation: F. Thelen, Optimierung einer Druckwechseladsorptionsanlage fuer die Gewinnung von hochreinem Wasserstoff, TU Wien, 2023
source.system: automated four-column H2/N2/CO/CO2/CH4 PSA pilot, maximum 1 Nm3/h feed and 7 bara

measurement_context.reported_feed_flow_sensitivity: a 1% feed-flow deviation causes an H2-recovery deviation of the same order

excluded_bp2_with_continuous_raffinate_a.reason: the analyser withdrew about 1 slm of raffinate and changed column pressurization; this is not the same operating pair

supported: same-chemistry H2 PSA evidence that a 0.25 bara increase in equalization pressure lowered recovery under an otherwise matched operating pair
the recovery direction is consistent for direct bellows-meter and pulse-transmitter calculations
the local recovery threshold is passed at both literature operating points
not_supported: validation of the local product-gas recycle fractions 0.420/0.427/0.430
validation of the frozen joint purity/recovery event because both literature purities are below 99.98%
reproduction of the local 0.420 policy selection or its event probabilities
synchronized raw historian validation or industrial plant validation

conclusion: Thelen VA-10 supplies an independent, same-chemistry, one-factor equalization-pressure control. Raising equalization pressure from 4.50 to 4.75 bara changes H2 recovery by -2.30 and -1.31 percentage points under the two reported measurement methods, while purity changes by -0.02 percentage point. This strengthens the process-mechanism evidence tier but does not close the same-policy, same-event validation gate.
